title: Extract pure logic from Operations for unit testing
description:
Extract ID matching, dependency checking, and summary aggregation logic from Operations into pure public functions that can be unit tested independently.

Current state:
- Operations::resolve_id mixes ID matching with storage.load_index()
- Operations::next mixes dependency traversal with storage.load_all_issues() and repeated storage.load_issue()
- Operations::summary mixes aggregation with storage.load_all_issues()

These algorithms are purely functional but hidden behind I/O dependencies, making them impossible to test without file system.

Required extractions:
- match_id_prefix(id_str: &str, known_ids: &[Uuid]) -> Result<Uuid>
- get_unblocked_issues(issues: &[Issue]) -> Vec<Issue>
- calculate_summary(issues: &[Issue]) -> ProjectSummary

After extraction, update:
- Operations::resolve_id to call match_id_prefix
- Operations::next to call get_unblocked_issues
- Operations::summary to call calculate_summary

Relationships:
  part of 1ac3f79e (Testability and Testing Epic)
  required for 4622175c (Add docstrings and doctests to non-obvious code)
